notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Slide on the ground after landing reduced a lot
- Added coyote time (Reddy can still jump a few milliseconds after walkingoff a ledge)
- Walljump buffer fixed (it exists now)
- Reddy is now invincible when holding bash and a few milliseconds after launching it
- Small changes in level 2-12, 3-4 and 3-11
- The mouse cursor doesn't appear anymore after selecting a level
